Test Case Title: TC0005_ Check adding assets to the learning

5. Add paged assets [PDF, DOC, PPT] from persoal drive

8. Add URL assets via add content URL
Expected Result:

Actual Result: User is able to add Paged assets [PDF, DOC, & PPT's] and link assets [URL's, CS assets]
